User_Story: As a CEO, I want to view a consolidated performance scorecard so that I can prioritize business investment.
Acceptance_Criteria: Order and value metrics reconcile to warehouse results

User_Story: As a Commercial Director, I want to analyze category and seller contributions so that I can identify growth concentration.
Acceptance_Criteria: Category breakdowns reconcile to the selected eligible total

User_Story: As a Customer Experience Lead, I want to identify customer behavior segments so that I can prioritize retention opportunities.
Acceptance_Criteria: Each eligible customer belongs to exactly one defined RFM segment

User_Story: As a Customer Experience Lead, I want to compare purchasing cohorts so that I can understand repeat purchase behavior.
Acceptance_Criteria: Cohorts use customer first purchase date and documented observation windows

User_Story: As a Operations Director, I want to analyze late deliveries so that I can prioritize logistics interventions.
Acceptance_Criteria: Late delivery calculations use valid actual and estimated delivery dates

User_Story: As a Marketplace Manager, I want to rank sellers by operational quality so that I can identify sellers needing support.
Acceptance_Criteria: Seller rankings display order volume alongside service measures

User_Story: As a Product Manager, I want to compare product category performance so that I can identify commercial opportunities.
Acceptance_Criteria: Category measures aggregate at the correct order-item grain

User_Story: As a Regional Manager, I want to investigate geographic differences so that I can prioritize regional operations.
Acceptance_Criteria: Regional assignments use documented customer and seller geography rules

User_Story: As a Analytics Manager, I want to inspect predictive risk and uncertainty so that I can evaluate possible proactive interventions.
Acceptance_Criteria: Holdout evaluation and prediction-time feature availability are documented

User_Story: As a Executive Sponsor, I want to simulate business intervention outcomes so that I can compare investment scenarios.
Acceptance_Criteria: Costs and benefits are traceable to explicit editable assumptions

User_Story: As a BI Product Owner, I want to filter and drill through reports so that I can investigate anomalies.
Acceptance_Criteria: Navigation preserves intended filter context and reconciles totals

User_Story: As a Data Governance Lead, I want to inspect definitions and refresh coverage so that I can trust reported information.
Acceptance_Criteria: The report exposes data periods and metric definitions
